$comment: Themes (and golden looks, `looks`: each a looks.golden variant id in webviews/src/gallery/golden/looks.json) whose own accent may be orange: the person picked an orange theme or look, so the 'the accent is never orange' invariant (webviews/test/accent-glass-invariants.test.ts, CmuxNextDesignTests/SystemAccentOrangeTests.swift) skips its orange-hue rule for them. The system-accent and opaque-glass rules still hold. Remove an entry to make that theme fail the rule too.
